snippet.title: DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY | Interviews with the Creators Behind Final Fantasy
snippet.description:
To celebrate the latest entry in the DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY series, DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY, we are pleased to present a special interview video with the creators behind Final Fantasy!

▼Featured Guests
Akitoshi Kawazu
Takashi Tokita
Naoki Yoshida
Yoshinori Kitase
Tetsuya Nomura (voice appearance only)
Naoya Matsumoto

*Game materials and footage recorded from a development build. Content subject to change.
